_notes: Message-match hero images for the ?v=<persona>-<age>-<tone> PDP variants. 5 age bands (18/25/35/45/55 = lower bound of the quiz age range) x 3 sellable tone bands (fair/medium/mediumdark). needs_product_images:false -> text-to-image, engine auto-adds 'do NOT show product/branding'. UGC selfie, NO product, demographic-matched RESULT skin (even, dewy). 4:5 portrait reads best in the hero's narrow left column. CANDID/UGC tone (v2): pushed toward a real casual phone selfie with natural skin texture and looser framing, keeping the warm muted Vera Lane aesthetic. After generation, convert+rename each to assets/lp-foundation-mmh-<age>-<tone>.jpg. TONE FIX: fair=pale Dutch, medium=German slight tan (NOT olive/golden), mediumdark=light Mediterranean tan.
